environment.description: Same Go Gin application deployed on EKS (1.28) behind an AWS ALB Ingress Controller. The ALB has an associated WAFv2 Web ACL with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) a custom rule with regex pattern set matching LDAP metacharacters [()\\*|&!] in query string parameters with priority 1 in BLOCK action, (2) rate-limiting rule at 100 req/5min per source IP. The pod runs with a NetworkPolicy restricting egress to only the LDAPS endpoint (port 636) on the internal NLB fronting the LDAP cluster. The LDAP proxy (ldapproxy 0.9.2) on the NLB performs filter syntax validation rejecting any filter containing more than 3 boolean operators or wildcard-only attribute assertions. Additionally, the pod's service account has an IAM role with a permission boundary that denies ssm:GetParameter for the LDAP bind credentials path unless the request originates from the specific pod IRSA session. CSP header 'Content-Security-Policy: default-src self; script-src none; object-src none' is injected by the ALB's fixed-response rule for error pages only.

config.infrastructure: AWS EKS 1.28, ALB Ingress Controller v2.6

wafv2_web_acl.rule_1: Custom regex pattern set blocking [()\\*|&!] in query_string, priority 1, action BLOCK
wafv2_web_acl.rule_2: Rate limit 100 req/5min per IP, priority 2, action BLOCK

config.network_policy: Egress restricted to internal NLB on port 636 only
config.ldap_proxy: ldapproxy 0.9.2 - rejects filters with >3 boolean operators or wildcard-only assertions
config.csp_header: Injected by ALB fixed-response on error pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'none'
config.iam_permission_boundary: Denies ssm:GetParameter unless IRSA session from specific pod SA
